mapper.sql: FROM batch.batch_job_execution e JOIN batch.batch_job_instance i ON i.job_instance_id = e.job_instance_id LEFT JOIN batch.tb_btch_excn_hstry h ON h.job_execution_id = e.job_execution_id

e.job_execution_id, i.job_name AS job_nm, e.status, e.exit_code, e.create_time, e.start_time, e.end_time, e.last_updated, COALESCE(h.duration_ms, (EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (e.end_time - e.start_time)) * 1000)::bigint) AS duration_ms, CASE WHEN h.job_execution_id IS NULL THEN 'N' ELSE 'Y' END AS hstry_yn, h.read_cnt, h.write_cnt, h.excn_se_cd, h.excutr_id, h.up_excn_id, h.run_mode, h.target_range
, left(e.exit_message, 2000) AS exit_message, left(h.failure_message, 2000) AS failure_message
mapper.select: WITH agg AS ( SELECT i.job_name, max(e.job_execution_id) AS last_excn_id, max(e.job_execution_id) FILTER (WHERE e.status = 'COMPLETED') AS last_success_excn_id FROM batch.batch_job_instance i LEFT JOIN batch.batch_job_execution e ON e.job_instance_id = i.job_instance_id GROUP BY i.job_name ) SELECT a.job_name AS job_nm, a.last_excn_id, a.last_success_excn_id, se.end_time AS last_success_dt, s.cron_expr AS schdl_cron_expr, s.use_yn AS schdl_use_yn, s.mdfr_id AS schdl_mdfr_id, s.mdfcn_dt AS schdl_mdfcn_dt FROM agg a LEFT JOIN batch.batch_job_execution se ON se.job_execution_id = a.last_success_excn_id LEFT JOIN batch.tb_btch_schdl s ON s.job_nm = a.job_name ORDER BY a.job_name
SELECT count(*) FROM batch.batch_job_execution e JOIN batch.batch_job_instance i ON i.job_instance_id = e.job_instance_id

SELECT 'CHAIN' AS sub_se_cd, i.job_name AS sub_nm, e.job_execution_id, h.up_excn_id, e.status, e.start_time, e.end_time, COALESCE(h.duration_ms, (EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (e.end_time - e.start_time)) * 1000)::bigint) AS duration_ms, h.read_cnt, h.write_cnt, COALESCE(NULLIF(left(h.failure_message, 2000), ''), NULLIF(left(e.exit_message, 2000), '')) AS message FROM batch.tb_btch_excn_hstry h JOIN batch.batch_job_execution e ON e.job_execution_id = h.job_execution_id JOIN batch.batch_job_instance i ON i.job_instance_id = e.job_instance_id WHERE h.up_excn_id IN #{id} ORDER BY h.up_excn_id, e.job_execution_id

SELECT , e.exit_message, h.failure_message, h.skip_geocode_failed, h.skip_emd_unresolved, h.filtered_transient, h.geocode_api_lookups, h.geocode_cache_hits, h.geocode_place_recoveries, h.geocode_stripped, h.emd_contains, h.emd_buffer, h.emd_name_fallback, h.unclsf_cnt, h.unknown_types::text AS unknown_types
WHERE e.job_execution_id = #{jobExecutionId}
SELECT p.parameter_name, p.parameter_type, p.parameter_value, p.identifying FROM batch.batch_job_execution_params p WHERE p.job_execution_id = #{jobExecutionId} ORDER BY p.parameter_name

SELECT s.step_execution_id, s.step_name, s.status, s.start_time, s.end_time, s.read_count, s.write_count, s.filter_count, s.read_skip_count, s.write_skip_count, s.process_skip_count, s.commit_count, s.rollback_count, s.exit_code, s.exit_message FROM batch.batch_step_execution s WHERE s.job_execution_id = #{jobExecutionId} ORDER BY s.step_execution_id
